name: typed-controls-only
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'rm -rf "$OUT/controls/.lake"' EXIT; bun lean-kernel/lift-typed/controls-from-project.ts checked-project; cd "$OUT/controls"; lake build CertificateBoundSubstitution TypedSource QAlpha RowAlpha > "$OUT/dependencies.log" 2>&1; lake env lean TypedControls.lean > "$OUT/typed-controls.log" 2>&1; lake env lean -o .lake/build/lib/lean/DataOnly.olean DataOnly.lean > "$OUT/data.log" 2>&1; lake env lean FullRoleControl.lean > "$OUT/full-role-control.log" 2>&1; cd "$ROOT"; bun lean-kernel/lift-typed/controls-audit.ts > "$OUT/audit.log" 2>&1
